brand.name: Boreal Grid
brand.tagline: Nordic and Baltic power markets, decomposed.
brand.description: Independent analysis of the Nordic and Baltic electricity markets — prices, flows, renewables build-out and the grid that has to carry it.
brand.comment: brand.name is a working title. Confirm it is clear of existing marks in the markets you publish into before you print it on anything.

newsletter.comment: formAction is the POST endpoint of your email provider (Buttondown, Kit, Mailchimp, Beehiiv, Listmonk...). emailField is the input name that provider expects. Until formAction is set, every signup form on the site renders in an unconnected state and says so rather than silently dropping addresses.
newsletter.name: The Monday Curve
newsletter.promise: One email a week. The Nordic and Baltic price action decomposed, plus the capacity, tender and grid-connection news that actually moves it.

reports.comment: Paid research. Set checkoutUrl on a tier to wire it to Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle or an invoice form. A tier with no checkoutUrl and no price falls back to the newsletter as a waitlist, and the card says so.

tiers.name: Single report
tiers.summary: One market, one question, answered with the working shown.
features: Every chart shipped as the underlying CSV
Scenario ranges with the assumptions listed, not buried
Twelve months of errata and data corrections

tiers.name: Research subscription
tiers.summary: Everything we publish, plus the tracker that sits behind it.
features: Every deep-dive report as it ships
Nordic–Baltic capacity and connection-queue tracker, updated monthly
Capture-price and spread series for FI, SE3, SE4, EE, LV, LT
Analyst Q&A on anything we have published

tiers.name: Desk and enterprise
tiers.summary: Your question, our data, under your assumptions.
features: Commissioned analysis on a defined question
Seat licences for a team or an investment committee
Model review — we mark your capture-price assumptions
Data delivered by API into your own stack

liveDataApp.comment: The live data app the market rail and the data panels will read from. Until url is set, the rail is labelled SAMPLE FEED and the calls to action point at the newsletter rather than pretending to be wired up.
liveDataApp.label: Open the live data app
